data.title: Augsburg vs Union Berlin prediction, preview & betting tips – 24/10/2026
data.content:
In their previous match, Manuel Baum’s men conceded three within the first half-hour in a 4-3 defeat to newly-promoted Elversberg. The result marked their fourth consecutive winless league outing.

Despite the winless streak, Augsburg boast a higher points tally after six rounds than in any of their previous five Bundesliga campaigns.

A handful of players are missing for Augsburg: Sima Suso, Alexis Claude-Maurice, Noahkai Banks, Tim Breithaupt and Stevie Mounie. [...] As for Union Berlin, they have six players sidelined. They are Andrik Markgraf, Stanley Nsoki, Andrej Ilic, Josip Juranovic, Oliver Burke and Livan Burcu.
